kitchenPantryPage.setupDialogDescription: Before you can organize your pantry items, you need to create a kitchen layout. Design your kitchen by adding cabinets, appliances, and storage elements.

kitchenLayoutEditor.designDescription: Design a 2D layout of your kitchen by adding cabinets, appliances, and storage elements. Once created, you can use it to organize your ingredients and equipment.

layoutEditorSteps.title: Welcome to Kitchen Layout Editor
layoutEditorSteps.content: Create a visual representation of your kitchen to organize your ingredients and equipment efficiently.

layoutEditorSteps.title: Adding Elements
layoutEditorSteps.content: Drag elements from the left panel onto the canvas. Elements include cabinets, appliances, and storage units.

layoutEditorSteps.title: Moving Elements
layoutEditorSteps.content: Click and drag elements to reposition them. Elements will snap to a grid and to other elements for easy alignment.

layoutEditorSteps.title: Resizing Elements
layoutEditorSteps.content: Select an element to see resize handles. Drag the handles to adjust the size. Elements are constrained to the canvas boundaries.

layoutEditorSteps.title: Customizing Elements
layoutEditorSteps.content: Right-click on any element to rename it, change its color, or manage shelves. Shelves help organize items within an element.

layoutEditorSteps.title: Managing Shelves
layoutEditorSteps.content: Add shelves to elements to create sections. Each shelf can store different items, making it easier to find what you need.

layoutEditorSteps.title: Ready to Start!
layoutEditorSteps.content: Once your layout is complete, go to the Kitchen Pantry page to start organizing your ingredients and equipment.

pantrySteps.title: Welcome to Kitchen Pantry
pantrySteps.content: Use your kitchen layout to organize and track where your ingredients and equipment are stored.

pantrySteps.title: Placing Items
pantrySteps.content: Drag ingredients or equipment from the right panel onto elements in your kitchen layout. Items will be stored in that location.

pantrySteps.title: Viewing Items
pantrySteps.content: Click on any element to see all items stored in it. Items are organized by shelves if you've configured them.

pantrySteps.title: Editing Layout
pantrySteps.content: Need to change your layout? Click the "Edit Layout" button to go back to the editor and make adjustments.

pantrySteps.title: Start Organizing!
pantrySteps.content: You're ready to organize your kitchen! Drag items to their storage locations and keep track of everything.
